primitives.note: A Thousand Cuts adds bonus magic damage to every basic attack on-hit, and to the center hit of Q and to R's needle hits.
A Thousand Cuts' bonus damage is 1% (+0.6%/100AP) of the target's current maximum health, applied per proc from autos, Q's snip centers, and R's needles.

A single Q cast fires 2-6 separate damage instances (1-5 mini-snips scaled by consumed Snippy stacks, plus one final snip dealing more damage), each center also converting 50% to true damage and applying A Thousand Cuts.
R can be recast up to two more times within 8s at no extra cost, firing 1, then 3, then 5 needles per cast (up to 9 total), each on a fixed 1s static-cooldown gap between casts.
Basic attacks on-hit generate Snippy stacks (cap 4, 6s duration, refreshed by further attacks); Q consumes all current stacks to add that many bonus mini-snips to its cast.
After the dash, Gwen's basic attacks for 4s deal 15 (+20% AP) bonus magic damage on-hit and gain range.
Casting Skip 'n Slash resets Gwen's basic attack timer and can be cast during any other ability (and vice versa), enabling attack-cancel weaving.
Gwen's first basic attack within E's empowered window refunds 25-65% of E's remaining cooldown.
E grants 30-80% bonus attack speed for 4 seconds, directly raising auto-attack (and on-hit rider) throughput.
While inside the mist, Gwen gains 22-30 (+7% AP) bonus armor and magic resistance -- relevant to the survival fight's damage taken, not the damage fight.

Ghosting, untargetability to enemy champions outside the mist, destruction of enemy targeted projectiles, and negation of monster damage from outside the mist -- all purely damage-taken/survival-fight mechanics with no counterpart in the damage fight.
Flat mana costs (40/60/35/100) with Gwen's modest mana pool can meaningfully cap how many Q/E/R casts fit in a 15s window, especially R at 100 per activation (recasts are free).

needsBespoke.why: Hallowed Mist's untargetability against enemy champions outside the zone is effectively a temporary, near-total incoming-damage negation window (not merely a resist/health buff, and not merely CC/mobility to ignore) with a geometric attacker-position condition ('outside the mist'). The closed primitive list has 'defensive-only' and 'timed-self-buff' for the resist gain, but nothing that expresses periodic full damage immunity conditioned on a position check the survival fight (no terrain, single stationary/attacking pair) would need to approximate or special-case. The simulator needs bespoke handling to decide whether/how W blocks the enemy's rotation while active.

unsettled.question: In the damage fight, should the Snippy-stack timing be treated as 'always at cap (4) when Q is cast' (best-case simulator assumption) or built up organically from actual auto-attack cadence within the 15s window, which could leave early Q casts with fewer than 4 stacks?
options: Assume Snippy is always fully stacked at 4 for every Q cast (idealized)
Simulate stack accumulation from the actual attack timeline, so early Q casts (before 4 attacks land) fire fewer mini-snips
quotes: '''Gwen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Snippy'' {{tip|on-hit}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times and refreshing on subsequent attacks.

proposal: Open by auto-attacking the dummy immediately to start generating Snippy stacks (each auto also procs A Thousand Cuts bonus magic damage).

Cast Skip 'n Slash (E) early to dash in (irrelevant for a stationary dummy but free), gaining the empowered on-hit magic damage, bonus attack speed, and an attack-timer reset so the next auto lands immediately.
Let the first auto-attack after E land to claim E's cooldown refund, then continue auto-attacking under the empowered/attack-speed buff.
Fire Needlework (R) as soon as available, immediately recasting twice (1-3-2s gaps) to unload all 9 needles, each applying A Thousand Cuts; keep auto-attacking between the short cast times.

Cast Snip Snip! (Q) once several Snippy stacks (ideally near the 4 cap) have accumulated, to maximize the number of mini-snips (each converting part to true damage and applying A Thousand Cuts) alongside the final snip.
Recast E again as soon as it comes off cooldown (shortened by the earlier refund) to refresh the attack-speed/on-hit window and reset the attack timer for another burst of empowered autos.
Recast Q again on cooldown (as low as 3.5s at rank 5) whenever new Snippy stacks have built up, continuing to weave auto-attacks between casts.
Recast R again once off cooldown near the end of the 15s window if mana and time allow.
Do not cast Hallowed Mist (W): it deals no damage and only provides resists/untargetability, which is irrelevant to maximizing damage output against a stationary dummy.
questions: Should Q be cast immediately at low/zero Snippy stacks for a fast minimum-damage burst, or delayed to pool stacks near the 4 cap for maximum mini-snip count, given Q's cooldown is often shorter than the 6s Snippy refresh window?
Is R best front-loaded as an opening 9-needle nuke, or held/staggered to land alongside E's on-hit buff and freshly stacked Snippy Q casts for maximum combined A Thousand Cuts procs?

How many auto-attacks realistically land between E's cast, its cooldown-refund proc, and its 4s empowered window given the target's attack speed and E's resets, to correctly time E recasts within 15s?
